notes: In Yin et al. (2022, J. Hydrol. 609, 127781), Day-1 Median NSE across the full basin set is 0.8265 (Section 4.1, p. 6, Fig. 4a & Tables 5-6; global pretraining w/o fine-tuning RR-Former2 = 0.7598), whereas 0.862 in Table 4 is Mean NSE on a 40-basin subset.
